book.name: MATAIYO
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Mataiyo wana Leleli

content: Gamagalau Alolon ana Hagali Hi Towani
Yeisu i ba gohalibe al gamagalau elal i ba,
“Yehoba wana abalogugui i ola hiwe. Kin etega hagali i ginol natuna melutauina wana alolon kaiwena.
Wana totuwalali i patunal hi na gamagalau bolo i awanunil elal wali wasa hi pek nihi nem hagali elana, yaa gamagalau o hi towa.

“Inoke wana totuwalali enuna al i patunal i ba, ‘Bolo ya awanunil hagali kaiwena wali wasa nuku pek aanan iyaka ya lovivina-an. Nuku ba: Bulumakau momomonel iyaka ha punel ge bugul gegewena iyaka ha lovivina-agil. Ku nem ya hagali elana.’
“Yaa heliya nige yayaluwaliya i nonoek, inoke etegana i na wana eyowaa, etegana i na wana sitowaa,
ge enuna totuwalali hi libil, hi nibihil ge hi tagapaaligal.
Kin i huga nabi, inoke wana tolohaveyan i patunal hi na totaulol hi tagapaaligal ge wali panuwa hi ton yoho.
“Inoke i ba wana totuwalali elal, ‘Alolon ana hagali iyaka ya lovivina-an, yaa bolo ya awanunil hi sigasiga ge nige hi nenem.
Ku na kamwasa lala elana. Ebo henalau nuku pwawal, nuku ba nihi nem hagali elana.’
Inoke totuwalali hi nok hi na kamwasa elal ge gamagalau gegewel bolo hi pwawal, waiwaisal ge nanakil, hi ahel hi pwatanim, yaka hagali limena i kalaopop.
“Sauga kin i ulutuk hagali limena elana ge gamagalau i kitel, yaka tau etega i kite pwawa alolon hagalena kalikona
nige i gagaloi.
I neli i ba, ‘Heliyam, ga i ola u nem u tuk ge nige alolon hagalena kalikona u gagaloi?’ Yaa tau o nige kin anana i lalahe.
Inoke kin i baek wana totuwalali elal i ba, ‘Nimana ge aena ku gimwan ge nuku alitagil-an gogouwa, ni kahikahin ge ninina ni alavekilal.’”
Inoke Yeisu i ba, “Hi gewi Yehoba i yogaagil, yaa ehila ya te i hilel.”
Takis ana Pwapwamola Bana
Inoke Palisi Yeisu hi eguluwai hi na hi nuwatu loyaloya ga nihi ginol ola ge Yeisu nihi paona ge wana baaba eliyana ana woliwoli nihi ginol.

Inoke wali gamagalau enuna hi patunal hi na Yeisu elana, avaliyau ge gamagalau enuna bolo nunuwaliya Helodi wana logugui. Hi baek elana hi ba, “Topankite, ha atena owa tobaaba tunahot ge wam panpankiti Yehoba kaiwena i sapu hot. Nige gamagal etega u lolovakun-an, kaiwena nige u gogoluek gamagalau wali siba ana miha elana.
Inoke nu ba naha hago. Mosese i ba mani naha pek Yehoba elana. He wam nuwatu ga i ola? I waisi ya takis naha pwamola Sisa elana o age bahiwa?”
Yeisu wali nuwatu nanakina iyaka i atena, inoke i baek elal i ba, “Tokakakawi hot komiu! Hauna kaiwena ku laboseyau tage nuku paonau?
Mani etega ku pankiteyau, toto tage takis ku pwapwamolaya.” Yaka mani silba etega hi ahe hi pek elana i kite,
inoke i nelil i ba, “Henala kakanununa ya? Ge henala alana hi leli mani ya tuwanaa?”
Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Sisa.” Inoke Yeisu i baek elal i ba, “Toto Sisa kaiwena nuku pek Sisa elana, ge toto Yehoba kaiwena nuku pek Yehoba elana.”
Wana baaba ya hi hago inoke nuwaliya hi ahe, yaka Yeisu hi eguluwai ge hi egon.
Toyaomal wali Lut Al Bana
Lan toto o elana, Sadiusi hi nem Yeisu elana. He Sadiusi nige wali abulilek i oola tage toyaomal nihi lut, inoke Yeisu hi neli hi ba,
“Topankite, Mosese i ba ebo tau etega ni alolon, nige natunau ge ni aliga, inoke abuabulina talina ni alolonan ge ebo natuliyau ni gan, heliya nihi tabwa tau toto i alaliga natunau.
Sauga etega tau etega alonau talinau, ali toto seben. Gamaun i alolon, nige natunau, yaka i aliga, inoke abuabulina talina i alolonan.
Pagan o maisena i gan al loena elana, i ola al etonina, ge i ola al ana siga gegewel hi pwawa.
Inoke mowamowasena, abwe yova al i aliga.
Ebo tunahot toyaomal abwe nihi lut, he lut enaa ali toto seben gamwaliyaa henala ge yova o lagona hot? Kaiwena gegewel hi alolonan ga.”
Yeisu analiya i lahe i ba, “Komiu ku gegi hot, kaiwena Buki Bwabwalena ana baaba ge Yehoba wana gasisi nige ku aatena.
Sauga ebo toyaomal nihi lut, nihi ola aneloseyau labulabumwa, nige nihi aalolon.
Yaa toyaomal wali lut bana, age Buki Bwabwalena nige ku vavasili ge nuku atena hauna gun Yehoba i baunan eliyamiu?

I ba, ‘Sauga ya nau Abalahama, Aisake ge Yakobo wali Yabowaine.’ Yehoba i ba ola o, inoke ta atena gamagalau ya yawaliliya nige i yayaomal hot. Yehoba iya nige toaliga hot wali Yabowaine i oola, yaa bolo yawaliliya gaganina wali Yabowaine.”
Yeisu wana baaba ya boda hi hago, inoke nuwaliya hi ahe wana panpankiti kaiwena.
Hauna Logugui I Bwata?
Palisi hi hago Yeisu Sadiusi iyaka i ba pamikekei-agil inoke Palisi hi nogogo.
Yaka avaliya etegana, Logugui ana toatena, Yeisu i labose ge i neli i ba,
“Topankite, hauna logugui i bwata Mosese wana Logugui elana?”
Anana Yeisu i lahe i ba, “‘Yehoba wam Yabowaine nu nunuwana-an ginebi ge atem bwalibwaligena, yawalim bwalibwaligena ge wam nuwatu bwalibwaligena.’
Logugui ya iya logugui bwabwatana ge logugui houwan.
Ge logugui labuina i ola al to, i ba, ‘Alom nu nunuwana-an ni ola totom u nunuwana-agiwa.’
Mosese wana Logugui gegewena ge palopitau wali panpankiti, puliya i talmilila logugui labui ya elal.”
Mesaiya Iya Deibid Tubuna, I Ola Al Iya Deibid wana Babala
He Palisi iyoho Yeisu hi mimipainan, inoke i nelil i ba,
“Ga ku nuwatu ola Mesaiya kaiwena? Henala tubuna iya?” Yaka hi ba, “Iya Deibid tubuna.”
Inoke Yeisu i nelil al i ba, “He ga i ola ge Deibid i baaba Yayaluwa Bwabwalena wana nuwatu elana ge Mesaiya i awa babala-an? Kaiwena Deibid i ba,

content.text: ‘Yehoba i baek no Babala elana i ba:
ana siga am topihigelgel na teli lowagil aem gabulanaa.’

content: He Deibid Mesaiya i awa babala-an, inoke ga i ola ge tage iya Deibid tubuna?”
Nige etega bosowailiya Yeisu anana nihi lahe, inoke nige sauga etega al bosowailiya nihi labose ge nel etega nihi neli Yeisu elana.

footnotes.text: Ana awa i ola tonhagali alolon hagalena kalikona i lovivina-an i pek toan hagali nihi galoi. Yaa tau ya nige tonhagali i aawatauwan, yaka i tuk bwagabwaga ya nige i nana hagali kalikona i aahe i gagaloi.
